### D32B

**Touch Mode**

Msetter: Touch. Off in Live View turns touch off while you shoot and keeps it for menus and pictures.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 0 (On)
- Cameras: all

The manuals only say that touch control can be switched off from firmware 2.0.0 (M-EV1 manual p.40, M11-P manual p.48).

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 0 | On |
| 1 | Off |
| 2 | Off (LV mode) |

### D01A

**Auto Review**

Msetter: Picture review. Shows each picture after you take it.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 1 (1 s) on the M11, M11-P, M11 Monochrom and M-EV1; 0 (Off) on the M11-D
- Cameras: all

How long each picture shows after it is taken (M-EV1 manual p.132).

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 0 | Off |
| 1 | 1 s |
| 3 | 3 s |
| 5 | 5 s |
| -1 | Permanent |
| -3 | Shutter Button Pressed |

### D020

**Focus Aid**

Msetter: Focus aid. Automatic magnifies the view when you turn the focus ring.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 1 (Automatic) on the M11, M11-P, M11-D and M11 Monochrom; 0 (Manual) on the M-EV1
- Cameras: all

Automatic magnifies the view when you turn the focus ring (M-EV1 manual p.86).

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 0 | Manual |
| 1 | Automatic |

### D0A2

**EVF-LCD**

Msetter: Screen or viewfinder. Where the picture shows. Auto switches with the eye sensor.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 0 (Auto)
- Cameras: all

Auto lets the eye sensor switch between viewfinder and screen. EVF extended uses the viewfinder for shooting and the eye sensor for pictures and menus (M-EV1 manual p.61).

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 2 | LCD |
| 0 | Auto |
| 3 | EVF extended |
| 1 | EVF |

### D134

**EVF Eye Sensor**

Msetter: Eye sensor. How readily the eye sensor switches to the viewfinder.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 1 (High)
- Cameras: all

Eye sensor sensitivity (M-EV1 manual p.62).

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 0 | Low |
| 1 | High |

### D01E

**Display Brightness**

Msetter: Screen brightness. Auto follows the light around you.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 15 (0)
- Cameras: all

Screen brightness: Auto, or -5 to +5 (M-EV1 manual p.62).

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 5 | Auto |
| 10 | -5 |
| 11 | -4 |
| 12 | -3 |
| 13 | -2 |
| 14 | -1 |
| 15 | 0 |
| 16 | +1 |
| 17 | +2 |
| 18 | +3 |
| 19 | +4 |
| 20 | +5 |

### D133

**EVF Brightness**

Msetter: Viewfinder brightness. For the electronic viewfinder or the Visoflex 2.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
